column2: [intro]
I’ve got robots and teddy bears, taking all the space
Knick-knacks piling up, it’s a frenzied embrace
Happiness in disorder, that’s my philosophy
In my joyful clutter, order is heresy!
In my joyful clutter, treasures are all around
Objects scattered, bringing joy that I’ve found
My home’s a museum, a celebration of heart
In my joyful clutter, I’m the queen of art!
Neighbors look at me strangely, thinking I'm mad
But I don’t care, saving each trinket makes me glad
Boxes filled with old memories, each one a precious find
In my joyful clutter, my treasures are mine!
In my joyful clutter, treasures are all around
Objects scattered, bringing joy that I’ve found
My home’s a museum, a celebration of heart
In my joyful clutter, I’m the queen of art!
